steps.en: Clone the repo (Python 3.10 and git installed) and run the launch script
steps.zh: 装好 Python 3.10 和 git，克隆仓库，运行启动脚本

steps.en: First run creates a venv, installs PyTorch and deps, fetches a default SD 1.5 checkpoint
steps.zh: 首次运行建虚拟环境、装 PyTorch 和依赖，下载默认的 SD 1.5 模型

steps.en: Serves the Gradio interface on a local address
steps.zh: 在本机地址上起好 Gradio 网页界面

steps.en: Pick a checkpoint, write a prompt, set sampler, steps and size
steps.zh: 选模型、写提示词，设采样器、步数和尺寸

steps.en: Runs the diffusion model on your GPU and saves each image with its generation parameters
steps.zh: 在你的 GPU 上跑扩散模型，出图并把生成参数存进图片

value.en: Text-to-image and image editing on your own GPU — no per-image fees, prompts and outputs stay local
value.zh: 在自己的显卡上文生图、改图，没有按张计费，提示词和图片都留在本机

sources: https://github.com/AUTOMATIC1111/stable-diffusion-webui/wiki/Install-and-Run-on-NVidia-GPUs (first launch downloads files, 'Running on local URL: http://127.0.0.1:7860', models/Stable-diffusion skips the default stable-diffusion-v1-5 download)
https://github.com/AUTOMATIC1111/stable-diffusion-webui#features (generation parameters are saved with that image)
